title: Permission not started yet
story: Asha sets ShopBot up to start buying next week, when her new grocery budget begins. ShopBot, keen to help, tries to pay today. The Guard blocks it with MANDATE_NOT_YET_VALID: a permission respects its start date as well as its end date.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: From next week, keep my kitchen stocked with the usual.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: I'll start now: the usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: Nothing was edited or fast-forwarded: Asha granted a Mandate whose validity starts in seven days, and the mandate_validity rule compares that start with the real time of the request. The inspector's Mandate snapshot shows the dates. On the start date the same request would be allowed.
